overview.description: The Defiance Robotics Actuators ETF (AT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The Defiance Robotics Actuators (AT) is the first US-listed ETF dedicated exclusively to the actuator layer of the humanoid robotics supply chain. The ETF seeks to track an index, of the 25 largest companies, globally, involved in motion components for robotics and weights them by a modified market-cap. AT was launched on Sep 14, 2026 and is issued by Defiance.
